description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector' which provides a framework for injecting tokens into an HTML document during parsing. It includes methods for preparing the injector, checking HTML validity, traversing tokens, and handling specific token types such as text, start, and end tags. The class is part of the HTMLPurifier library and is instrumental in customizing HTML content processing, such as well-formedness, auto-paragraphing, or adding custom elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for injecting tokens into an HTML document during parsing, facilitating tasks like auto-paragraphing or add-on modifications.

methods.name: rewindOffset
methods.description: Sets the rewind offset to revisit previous tokens during parsing.

methods.name: getRewindOffset
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the current rewind offset.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the injector with configuration and context, setting necessary internal references.

methods.name: checkNeeded
methods.description: Checks if the current HTML environment supports required elements and attributes for the injector.

methods.name: allowsElement
methods.description: Determines if the current context allows a specific HTML element.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Moves forward through input tokens, updating the current token.

methods.name: forwardUntilEndToken
methods.description: Traverses tokens until reaching the end token of the current node, managing nesting levels.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Moves backward through input tokens, updating the current token.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Handle processing of text tokens; can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handle processing of start or empty element tokens; can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handle processing of end tokens; calls notifyEnd.

methods.name: notifyEnd
methods.description: Notifies when an end token is processed; deprecated method.
